articles.headline: World Cup final LIVE: Spain, Argentina face off in New Jersey
articles.description: Enjoy all the features, news, video analysis and color from around the World Cup as Spain and Lamine Yamal take on Argentina and Lionel Messi in the final.

articles.headline: Infantino's epic World Cup tour: FIFA president clocked up over 65,000 miles
articles.description: From the 2026 World Cup opener in Mexico City to the final in New Jersey, FIFA president Gianni Infantino flew the equivalent of 2½ times around the Earth.

articles.headline: Argentina's Lisandro Martínez forced off injured in World Cup final vs. Spain
articles.description: Argentina centre-back Lisandro Martínez was forced off in the first half of the World Cup final against Spain.

articles.headline: 2026 World Cup final: President Trump, Timothée Chalamet headline celebrities in attendance
articles.description: Celebrities aren't hard to find at the 2026 FIFA World Cup in North America.

articles.headline: Lionel Messi becomes first man to start three World Cup finals
articles.description: Lionel Messi has officially become the oldest outfield player to ever take the field in a World Cup final, after starting for Argentina as they take on Spain.

articles.headline: Harry Kane warns England are 'still in that grieving stage' but strongly backs Thomas Tuchel
articles.description: Harry Kane admitted England will be "grieving" their World Cup heartbreak for some time to come although he backed Thomas Tuchel to stay on as head coach.
